text:
```yaml
name: Claude Spellcheck

on:
  pull_request:
    types: [opened, synchronize, reopened]

permissions:
  contents: write
  pull-requests: write

jobs:
  spellcheck:
    runs-on: ubuntu-latest
    steps:
      - name: Checkout repository
        uses: actions/checkout@v4

      - name: Run Claude Spellcheck
        id: claude
        uses: anthropics/claude-code-base-action@beta
        with:
          prompt: |
            You are a spellchecker. Review the code in this PR for spelling mistakes and suggest corrections. Output a diff of changes to apply.
          max_turns: 1
          model: claude-3-5-sonnet-20240620
          anthropic_api_key: ${{ secrets.ANTHROPIC_API_KEY }}

      - name: Apply Claude diff
        run: |
          if [ -f "${{ steps.claude.outputs.execution_file }}" ]; then
            git apply "${{ steps.claude.outputs.execution_file }}"
          fi

      - name: Commit spellcheck changes
        uses: EndBug/add-and-commit@v9
        with:
          message: "Apply spellcheck corrections"
          add: .
          author_name: Claude Bot
          author_email: claude@example.com
          commit: true
          push: true
```
